Residents:

Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls). Both were home for all Saturday patrols (00:00–20:00), consistent with weekend routine. Friends visited Friday evening; no specific guest object movements noted.
